title: Byzantine Empire (330-1453)
key_facts: Eastern Roman Empire continuation after Rome's fall
Christian Orthodox empire preserving classical knowledge
Constantinople as largest European city for centuries
causes: Constantine's founding of new capital Constantinople
Christianity as state religion unifying diverse populations
Military organization with theme system and Greek fire
outcome: Gradual territorial loss to Muslim powers
Fall of Constantinople ended empire in 1453
Legacy preserved in Orthodox Church and Russian claims
Cultural and scholarly contributions to Renaissance
impacts: Preserved classical Greek and Roman knowledge
Spread Orthodox Christianity throughout Eastern Europe
Influenced Islamic civilization through contact and conflict
Contributed to European Renaissance through scholars
